conviction_note: Nothing decisive. The FY26/8 shortfall against the company plan (sales about -7%, OP about -5%) was flagged by the company in its Q3 deck and already sits in the one-source consensus (OP 2,700 against a 2,850 plan), so the print turns on the FY27 guide, and no FY27 bar can be sourced. The findings sum to +0.4, mostly an inference that the depressed FY26 H1 base makes a growth guide likely. The scaled number is slightly negative (p_up 48 x 6.0) because both prior full-year prints were sold (-8.21% on 2024-10-16, -6.95% on 2025-10-16, the second despite a +11% guide and a dividend raise) and 信用倍率 sits at 4.45. Two weak leans with opposite signs: the honest reading is a coin flip with a large scale.
bar: FY26/8 consensus from kabuyoho (fetched 2026-10-14, unchanged 1 and 4 weeks earlier): sales 25,400 / OP 2,700 / ordinary 2,750 / NP 1,750 (JPY m), against a company plan of 27,400 / 2,850 / 2,880 / 1,870 that was never revised (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6199). Only one consensus source could be read. A search snippet carried a conflicting 2026-07-22 figure of OP 2,500, so the bar is not two agreeing sources and every size is capped small. No FY27 consensus or 四季報 number was reachable (shikiho returned a shell), so the FY27 guide, the item that decides this print, is unsourced.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-14: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (a real zero), and no change (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per the sealed baseline). 信用倍率 4.45 (kabutan quote header, 2026-10-15), so margin longs outnumber margin shorts about 4.5:1. No options, so no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.295, almost all of it the margin overhang. Run-up -0.58% over 20 days and +2.56% over 5 days; the stock went from 1,230 after Q3 to 1,463 on 2026-09-18 and back to 1,364. The company buyback is still buying in the market: 35,200 shares in September, about 8% of the roughly 20k shares a day that trade. Fidelity/FMR crossed 5% in April to June 2026. The Nikkei was down 3.9% this morning, which is macro and not filed.

findings.finding: FY26/8 will land below the never-revised company plan: Q4 would need sales of 8,490m against 6,421m in Q3 (the deck says sales are '計画に対して遅れ' because partner-engineer deployments missed plan), and Q4 OP has run about 16% below Q3 (541 against 644 last year), which implies FY OP of about 2,700m against the 2,850 plan. That is the first plan miss after FY25 met its plan exactly, but it equals the kabuyoho consensus (25,400 / 2,700).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-07-15 15:30, ordinary-profit progress 71.6% against a five-year average of 81.5%, plan held): the stock fell 3.15% on 07-16 by the tape. The baseline row dated 2026-07-14 (+3.54) is on a wrong estimated date.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. Anyone can compute the shortfall from the Q3 短信, the company stated it in its own deck, and consensus already sits at OP 2,700 and sales 25,400. Filed because it is sourced, and sized near zero under the visible-miss rule. If it were not priced, consensus would still sit at the plan.
findings.independence: Consensus at the same level (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6199, fetched 2026-10-14). The progress-rate arithmetic is from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6199&b=k202607150069), which reads the same Q3 短信, so they count once.

findings.finding: The FY27 guide is set against a depressed base. FY26 H1 OP was 1,201m (-11% YoY, after an H1 plan of 1,030m), while Q3 OP was 818m (+27% YoY, margin 12.7%). A year-on-year profit-growth guide, including for H1, is therefore likely even if sales growth stays slow, and that removes last year's sell trigger (the FY26 guide carried an H1 OP of -24.6%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Full-year prints: 2024-10-15 release, -8.21% next session; 2025-10-15 release (FY26 guide OP +11.7%, H1 OP -24.6%, dividend +4.2 yen), -6.95% next session. Both are actual dates read off the tape.
findings.why_not_priced: No FY27 consensus is published anywhere reachable, so the market has no stated FY27 bar. At about 10x consensus EPS the stock is not priced for growth. If it were priced, the stock would have re-rated after Q3's +27% OP, and it fell 3.15% on that print. This is inference, not a document: the guide itself is unknown, and the partner-engineer shortfall could just as easily produce a low sales guide, which caps the size.
findings.independence: Quarterly OP series from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6199): Q1 582, Q2 619, Q3 818. It is the same company data, so the support is weak.

findings.finding: Capital returns continue but are known. The 2026-07-27 programme (500k shares / ¥500m to 2027-06-30) had bought 226,700 shares for ¥299.8m by 2026-09-30, leaving about ¥200m, and is buying about 35k shares a month in the market. The FY26 dividend forecast is 17.4 yen (16.9 performance-linked plus 0.5 from the cancellation, payout about 12%). The two previous buybacks were announced in August 2025 and July 2026, not at the full-year print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-15 print with a +4.2 yen dividend raise: -6.95%. The buyback announcement of 2025-08-07 was bought ('しっかり', kabutan 2025-08-08), and the ToSTNeT-3 buyback of 2026-07-27 gave +2.34% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the programme is public and partly executed. What is left is the FY27 dividend guide, likely raised if NP grows under a performance-linked policy, and a small upside tail of a new or expanded buyback. The downside is a trim of the performance-linked 16.9 yen if NP misses 1,870, which the company has not done before.
findings.independence: Deck p.12, dividend policy (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594357.pdf). It is the same company.

findings.finding: Positioning leans long and leveraged: 信用倍率 4.45 with no disclosed shorts, against a full-year-print reaction history that is negative 2 of 2. The founders' 9-30 change report (宮崎浩美 8.47% to 8.03%) is a collateral-contract filing that reflects the July ToSTNeT-3 sale to the company, not new selling.
findings.why_not_priced: The margin overhang is already the main component of priced_lean_pct (-0.32), so this mostly agrees with the baseline. It is filed small, only as the setup in which a disappointing guide still finds sellers.
findings.independence: The change-report reason '担保契約等重要な契約の変更' is from M&A Online (https://maonline.jp/kabuhoyu/sh-s100z4sj). The founders' participation in the ToSTNeT-3 sale is in the company's 2026-07-27 notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260727/140120260727599866.pdf).

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed. This is the FY end, and the shortfall against plan (sales about -7%, OP about -5%) is under the TSE revision thresholds and already in consensus. Returns: a buyback is running with about ¥200m left; the FY27 dividend guide is likely higher under the performance-linked policy; a new buyback at the print would break the company's habit. New-year guide: the deciding item, with no sourced bar; the company habitually guides about +10-12% OP and met FY25 exactly. Quarter: Q3 cumulative ordinary progress 71.6% against a five-year average of 81.5% and 78.9% last year, already known since July.

baseline_tension: The findings roughly agree with the baseline. The lean is -0.3 (margin overhang), the run-up is flat, and the visible FY miss is already in consensus. The strongest positive the release could carry is a growth guide for FY27 on a depressed H1 base, a higher dividend guide or a new buyback. I looked for all three and none has a sourced bar, so the lean is not made larger than the baseline's.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute is priced): the FY plan-miss finding moved from -0.3 to -0.1.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives; check the sign): the strongest positives (FY27 growth guide, dividend, buyback) were written into baseline_tension. p_up moved from 47 to 48 because the 2-of-2 negative reaction history at full-year prints is a two-point sample. The positioning finding moved from -0.3 to -0.2.
Left standing: the guidance finding (+0.5), the capital-return finding (+0.2) and abs_move_pct 6.0.
